🔥 The fire settles. Sam has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Victor mutters "We've been walking past those." the person in their 40s, with a scarred cheek asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

opens.openerLine: "So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"About your plan here — So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"Hey." Victor settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"About what you did with your hands — You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"About the most useful thing you've learned — What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"Between us — Can I tell you something? I'm keeping a photo of someone I left behind. I haven't told anyone."
Carlos: "I've heard good things about Emberhold. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"About the kindest thing someone's done for you — What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
The System is a locked door. I'm collecting keys.
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Darius? Worth considering."
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all. No pressure, though."
"Have you ever hurt someone? Since all this started."
Sam: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"What got you through the first week? The very first days. That's the priority."
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Salman?"
"Hah. What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"What do you miss most? From before."
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"Can I be honest? Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"About teaching them something — Teach me something. Anything you know that I don't."
"Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"About who you don't trust — Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"Can we talk?" Vito sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
Whatever did this — it had a reason. Reasons can be found. That's what I believe.
"Can I tell you something? I saw something in the woods I'm not telling anyone about."
"Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
"What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"Can I tell you something? I know who took the extra rations but won't say."
"About what you believe in — Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything. Seen worse."
"Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"Water's almost gone — 2 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"Water's almost gone — 7 liters. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About what you did for fun — What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday. I don't know, though."
"I asked Hazel about whether you're staying — Hazel's gone. Are you going to stay? With us. For real. I mean it."
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it? Not that it matters."
"I asked Hazel about the creek water run — Hazel's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about? Forget it."
"The creek water run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
"I asked Ruby about what you're good at — Ruby's gone. What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about?"
"About the creek water run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
Sofia: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it? Could be wrong, though."
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"Well now — They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet…"
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"Can I tell you something? At night I count the stars and name them after people."
"Honestly, Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"My cut needs a second pair of hands. Will you help me clean it?"
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"Here's the thing: They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"I think better alone. Doesn't mean I'm not listening."
"Maybe — Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
Srinivas: "I've heard good things about Emberhold. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan. ...never mind."
"Can I trust you? I mean really."
"...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part. You'll see."
"Can I tell you something? I have been lying about my age — I'm younger than I look. That's the priority."
"Water's almost gone — 4 liters. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About the talking-to-strangers part — ...Hi. Sorry. I'm not good at the talking-to-strangers part."
"About whether they can trust you — Can I trust you? I mean really. Could be wrong, though."
"About whether they can trust you — Can I trust you? I mean really."
"I think — They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"I asked Tariq about the creek water run — Tariq's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
